section: Who this applies to
guide_wording: [Basque Economic Agreement art. 7](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2002-9969#a7) assigns ordinary employment withholding by where work/services are performed. Where common/Basque work is mixed or its location cannot be determined, use the assigned work centre; telework, foreign work and the specified sea-platform work follow that centre. Apply the competent Basque territory's rules, rather than the employee's annual IRPF residence alone. Pensions/public-system benefits generally follow recipient residence. Directors have payer-domicile and joint corporate-tax allocation rules. State public-sector pay has its separate State allocation and listed institutional exceptions. An employee living in Madrid but assigned to a Bilbao centre for telework does not acquire the State payroll algorithm simply from that residence.
provision: Economic Agreement article 7
quote: En el supuesto de que los trabajos o servicios se presten en territorio común y vasco o no se pueda determinar el lugar en donde se realicen los trabajos o servicios, se considerará que los trabajos o servicios se prestan en el territorio donde se ubique el centro de trabajo al que esté adscrita la persona trabajadora.

section: Who this applies to
guide_wording: [Navarra Economic Agreement art. 10](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1990-31117#a1-13) similarly assigns ordinary work in Navarra, mixed/indeterminate work by assigned centre and telework/foreign work to that centre. It separately assigns Navarra/local public employees, route transport workers by payer domicile, pensions and directors under their specified limbs, with State public-sector exceptions and compensation provisions. Keep the final annual-residence tax calculation and the withholding administration as separate determinations. Obtain actual work, centre-assignment, payer and residence records.

quote: En el supuesto de que los trabajos o servicios se presten en territorio común y navarro, o no se pueda determinar el lugar donde se realicen los trabajos o servicios, se considerará que los mismos se prestan en Navarra cuando se ubique en este territorio el centro de trabajo al que esté adscrita la persona trabajadora.

guide_wording: The following **flat withholding percentages**, rather than marginal tax brackets, are identical in all three independently read 2026 regulations: Bizkaia DF 47/2014 art. 88.1 (amended DF 134/2025), Álava DF 40/2014 art. 84.1 (DF 42/2025), Gipuzkoa DF 33/2014 art. 100.1 (DF 27/2025).
